title.value: AN ACT RELATING TO HEALTH AND SAFETY -- TOXIC PACKAGING REDUCTION ACT
title.provenance: AN ACT RELATING TO HEALTH AND SAFETY -- TOXIC PACKAGING REDUCTION ACT

status.provenance: Introduced By: Representatives Cortvriend, Speakman, Carson, Morales, Marszalkowski,  McGaw, Ruggiero,  Fogarty, Donovan, and Kislak

pfas_definition.provenance: 'Perfluoroalkyl  and polyfluoroalkyl  substances' or 'PFAS' means all  members of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing  at least one fully fluorinated  carbon atom.

type.provenance: This act would prohibit  the sale or promotional  distribution  of any food package in Rhode Island which contains perfluoroalkyl  and polyfluoroalkyl  substances (PFAS)

who.provenance: No product shall  be offered for sale or for promotional purposes by its manufacturer or distributor

action.provenance: No product shall  be offered for sale or for promotional purposes

products.provenance: any food package in Rhode Island which contains perfluoroalkyl  and polyfluoroalkyl  substances (PFAS)

intentionally_added.provenance: which contains perfluoroalkyl  and polyfluoroalkyl  substances (PFAS) ... have been intentionally introduced during manufacturing or distribution
